title: Were federal awards recorded during a recipient’s exclusion?
question: Does the same federal entity identifier occur in the exclusion list and the City or San Francisco award files?
finding: The City subaward file has 1,102 records. 1,102 carry a usable recipient ID and 0 match the national exclusion snapshot. Across the broader San Francisco prime-award extract, 1 recipient record matches and 0 began during a listed exclusion.
how: Exact, non-placeholder 12-character Unique Entity IDs. The SAM snapshot contains 169,188 entries, including 47,710 with usable IDs (38,449 distinct). Compare both the base award action and the latest reported action to the exclusion period. City and citywide populations overlap.
limits: One snapshot cannot recover exclusions removed earlier. Many prime awards lack identifiers. Intermediate transactions, amendments and payments to undisclosed lower-tier vendors are outside this test.

rows.cohort: Subawards reported under City prime awards
